title: 可爱的上海赤壁旅游海报
author: 小英镑知识分享
categories: 海报 / 传单,社交媒体帖子,3D 渲染,Q版 / 萌系,城市景观 / 街景,角色
prompt_en:
Goal: Create a cute chibi travel-blogger poster themed around Shanghai, with adorable miniature travelers exploring a giant 3D Chinese-character city title as the visual centerpiece.

Canvas: Vertical 2:3 poster, bright dreamy sky-blue background with fluffy clouds, scrapbook travel-journal collage aesthetic, warm pastel lighting, highly detailed but soft and cute.

Main layout: Place enormous glossy 3D sculptural Chinese characters spelling 上海 in the center, occupying most of the poster. The characters should be cream-colored with metallic beveled edges, rounded corners, and deep inset windows. Inside the strokes of the characters, show vivid miniature cityscape scenes: Shanghai skyline, the Oriental Pearl Tower, skyscrapers, waterfront night views, historic Bund architecture, Nanjing Road neon signs, boats on the river, and warm sunset-to-night lighting. The 3D text should feel like a walkable miniature city installation.

Characters: Include exactly 5 cute Japanese-style chibi travel bloggers, all with soft round faces, tiny bodies, beige travel outfits, bucket hats or caps, backpacks, and camera/travel accessories. Count and place them as follows: 1 small seated traveler with a camera on the upper-left ledge near the Oriental Pearl Tower; 1 walking traveler on the upper-right holding a folded map; 1 standing traveler in the center lower area on the 3D text, like a tiny explorer; 1 larger traveler at the bottom-left foreground holding a camera while walking; 1 traveler at the lower-right sitting or leaning with an orange suitcase. Their faces may be simplified or softly obscured, but the poses must remain expressive and travel-blogger-like.

Travel collage details: Add exactly 10 prominent paper and stamp elements around the central city text: 1 vintage postcard stamp in the top-left reading “SHANGHAI” with smaller Chinese/Shanghai travel markings; 1 circular airplane passport stamp overlapping it; 1 handwritten title at the top center with Chinese text “旅行日志” and English text “Travel Diary”; 1 taped note in the top-right with Chinese handwritten romantic travel text and a doodled heart; 1 black vintage camera sticker near the note; 1 circular Shanghai passport stamp at upper-right reading “SHANGHAI / 上海 / 20.24.05.20”; 1 “I ♥ SH” sticker on the right; 1 boarding-pass ticket at the bottom-left with PVG, gate, seat, and Shanghai details; 1 small red luggage-label sign at the bottom center reading “上海 / SHANGHAI”; 1 postcard at the bottom-right reading “SHANGHAI / The City / That Holds / All My Dreams” with a small skyline photo.

Left-side itinerary text: Add a handwritten checklist on the left with exactly 6 destination bullets: 东方明珠, 外滩, 南京路步行街, 田子坊, 武康大楼, 迪士尼乐园. Include dotted route arrows and a small phrase “Have a nice trip!” nearby.

Bottom caption: Handwrite a short Chinese travel note near the bottom center: “下一站，上海 遇见更好的自己”, with tiny smiley doodles and stamp marks.

Visual style: Japanese soft-cute Q-version illustration mixed with polished 3D typography and travel scrapbook collage; pastel colors, creamy highlights, sparkling city reflections, small petals/leaves, decorative tape, paper textures, soft shadows, cinematic fantasy realism, extremely charming and detailed.

Constraints: Keep the huge 3D city text readable as 上海, make the city landmarks recognizable, use exactly 5 chibi travelers, preserve the listed English and Chinese visible text, avoid logos or watermarks, no extra main characters.\

The composer has wild dark-gray curly hair, wears a dark green velvet coat over a white shirt and waistcoat, and his face is intentionally obscured by a centered square blur. Add period props: stacked leather-bound books on both sides of the desk, loose manuscript sheets, an open inkwell, a quill in the composer’s hand, a brass candleholder, and scattered papers on side tables. prompt_en:
Subject: A May Day for Records

Person/Expression: Japanese woman in her early 20s, dark brown medium hair, thin bangs, translucent skin, natural Japanese-style makeup, gentle and calm atmosphere. The face is almost completely hidden by a 12-inch record jacket, so that the female portrait on the jacket cover appears naturally as the person's own face.

Clothing/Pose: Warm-toned Japanese style coordinate suitable for May, light peach-beige sheer cardigan, soft ivory blouse or dress, spring-like thin material. The woman holds the record jacket in front of her face with both hands, so the positions of the hands and the angles of the arms naturally connect with the shoulders, arms, and posture of the person on the jacket cover. The color, texture, and silhouette of the clothes should also have a high sense of unity with the person on the jacket.

Background/Light: Inside a record shop with the warmth of wood, an aisle with record shelves on both sides, a space with depth. Soft warm-toned indoor lighting and natural ambient light, gentle shadows, and a slightly nostalgic atmosphere.

Composition/Camera: Vertical composition, centered on the upper body, with the record jacket placed large in the center of the frame. A composition where the person from the completed album cover appears to emerge into real space. Not cutting and connecting only half the face, but naturally merging the completed figure on the jacket cover with real hands, body, and clothes. 50mm to 85mm portrait lens, shallow depth of field, realistic snapshot style with appropriately blurred background.

Texture/Style: High-definition, photorealistic, 8K quality, natural skin texture, realistic hand texture, paper quality of the record jacket and fine reflections from shrink wrap, soft film feel. prompt_en: Create a wide hand-drawn editorial illustration of a surreal professional restaurant kitchen for a cursed repo visualization. Use a 16:9 canvas with a slightly elevated three-quarter view down a long white marble prep counter. The scene should feel like a whimsical, cursed software-repository metaphor rendered as a detailed ink-and-watercolor kitchen: warm cream walls, dark cabinetry, copper pans hanging along the back wall, brass pendant lamps, recipe tickets clipped to rails, towels on hooks, a chalkboard menu with illegible scribbles, stacks of plates, folded napkins, knives, tongs, saucepans, steaming bowls, and many tiny handwritten ingredient labels with mostly nonsensical text. Include exactly 5 human chefs: 1 dim ghostlike chef on the far left fading into a dark vignette, 1 chef at the left-center counter plating food, 1 partially obscured chef near the back center leaning over a pot, 1 large main chef seen from behind in the foreground wearing a tall toque and black-and-white checkered pants, and 1 chef on the right actively stirring a pan. Add exactly 1 anthropomorphic shrimp chef mascot standing on a small wooden step stool at the lower right, wearing a white chef coat and tall chef hat, holding a fan of pink order tickets like playing cards. The counter should contain exactly 12 prominent plated or bowled food items: 1 covered silver cloche near the lower left, 1 bowl of pale round beans labeled like gibberish, 1 bowl of mixed diced ingredients, 1 white plate of golden balls, 1 small red sauce bowl, 1 copper pan of round items steaming near the center, 1 plated tiny arrangement being assembled by the left-center chef, 1 central lidded or domed dish, 1 shallow bowl of grain-like filling, 1 reddish stew bowl, 1 white plate with a tiny plated garnish on the right, and 1 white plate of browned round bites at the far right. Scatter many small paper labels in front of the dishes; make the labels look hand-lettered and intentionally wrong or hard to read, including fragments resembling “BRUNCISE,” “JULIENNE,” “CANDI HANGER,” and other pseudo culinary/software terms. The left third of the image should be covered by a heavy dark smoky shadow and the right side should be clearer and warmer, creating an ominous-to-comedic contrast. Keep all text small, imperfect, and mostly illegible except for a few goofy labels. prompt_en:
Goal: Create a wide comparison image showing three side-by-side Japanese beauty serum promotional banner variants for the modern Japanese skincare brand NOBUNOSUKE, advertising a Rakuten Happy Bag sale.

Canvas: Horizontal 3-panel comparison layout, approximately 1200×500 px. Add a black header strip across the top with three white lowercase labels centered over each panel: exactly 3 labels, left to right: “low”, “medium”, “high”. Below the header, divide the image into exactly 3 equal vertical banner panels separated by thin dark gaps.

Overall visual style: Luxurious Japanese modern cosmetics advertising for women in their 30s–40s. Use an elegant palette of ivory, deep vermilion red, muted gold, warm beige, and subtle black accents. Backgrounds should feel like premium washi paper with gold flecks, wave patterns, red circular motifs, folding fans, plum blossoms, mizuhiki cord ornaments, and glossy water reflections at the bottom. Typography should mix large elegant serif English lettering with small refined Japanese copy.

Required repeated elements in every panel: exactly 1 brand logo near the top, exactly 1 large “HAPPY BAG” headline, exactly 1 red circular Rakuten-limited badge reading “楽天限定”, exactly 1 discount offer showing 20%OFF, and exactly 1 main product display with skincare serum packaging.

Panel 1, labeled low: Compose a cream-and-red banner with a large red sun circle behind the product on the right. Place the brand logo and small Japanese brand text at top center, a large gold “HAPPY BAG” headline on the left, a red “楽天限定” badge near the upper right, and a product set consisting of exactly 2 items: one amber glass dropper serum bottle with gold cap and white label, and one tall white product box beside it. Add white plum blossoms and a partially open gold folding fan around the product. Add Japanese copy under the headline, then a small red tag reading “今だけ” above a large red “20% OFF”. Put a red footer strip along the bottom with small white Japanese text indicating limited quantity and sale ending when sold out.

Panel 2, labeled medium: Compose a cleaner ivory banner with red curved paper shapes at the left bottom and right side, gold flecks, floral motifs, and a red folding fan in the upper right. Place the brand logo at top center, large dark red “HAPPY BAG” headline centered-left, and a red “楽天限定” badge at the upper right. Show exactly 4 product items centered-right: two tall cylindrical bottles with gold caps, one shorter serum bottle with pump/dropper styling, and one white rectangular box behind them with a red mizuhiki cord decoration. Add a discount block at lower left reading small vertical Japanese text “最大” and large “20% OFF”. Add two lines of small Japanese seasonal beauty copy near the bottom center.

Panel 3, labeled high: Compose a deeper luxury banner with cream background, red-and-gold arch brushstroke behind the product, red fan and plum blossoms on the right, and reflective water at the bottom. Place the brand logo at upper left, a small gold bow/mizuhiki motif above the headline, and a large red “HAPPY BAG” headline on the left. Add a red circular “楽天限定” badge at upper right. Show exactly 2 product items on the right-center: one black glass dropper serum bottle with gold cap and dark label, and one tall white product box beside it. Add small Japanese copy under the headline, a vertical red tag reading “特別価格” next to a large gold-red circular discount area showing “20% OFF”, and a dark red footer strip with small white Japanese text about limited quantity and sale ending when sold out.

Constraints: Keep all three panels visually similar but not identical, as if comparing low, medium, and high quality outputs of the same prompt. Maintain crisp premium product-ad composition, readable main English text, realistic cosmetic packaging, refined Japanese ornamentation, and no extra panels or watermarks.\
